title: Insane freezing on IOS 17.3 / IPhone 12
body:
Since updated from IOS 14 to IOS 17.3, this application started to freeze and lag at any event attempted to be opened. Having just 3 remote calendars attached, I’m unable to open any event, when attempting, the app freezes and doesn’t even respond when swiped from control menu. After a few relaunches or even device restart it finally loads back and the circle begins. Future days are not loading sometimes and it doesn’t self-heal until device reloads.
Thanks for breaking features in IOS 15.
author: E Aksenov
